stories.title: 66'000 Autos in der Schweiz – VW-Rückruf: Diese Modelle sind betroffen – und das ist zu tun

en.title: 66,000 cars in Switzerland – VW recall: These models are affected – and here's what to do
en.summary: Volkswagen is conducting a worldwide precautionary recall of millions of vehicles. Approximately 66,000 cars in Switzerland are affected by this action.

stories.title: Accueilli comme une rock star à Paris, le pape Léon XIV défie la France sur la fin de vie et la laïcité

en.title: Welcomed like a rock star in Paris, Pope Leo XIV challenges France on end-of-life issues and secularism
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV completed his first day in France at the Stade de France with approximately 80,000 young people. During his visit, the pontiff spoke against euthanasia and advocated for religion's role in public life.

stories.title: Après la liesse populaire et Notre-Dame, accueil de rock star au Stade de France pour Léon XIV

en.title: After popular celebrations and Notre-Dame, rock star welcome at the Stade de France for Leo XIV
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV concluded his first full day of pontifical visit to France with young people at the Stade de France. The day featured strong statements from the pope on societal matters following celebrations throughout Paris and at Notre-Dame.

stories.title: Auch Breel Embolo verpasst die Nations-League-Spiele – der Schweizer Fussball macht gerade gar keine gute Falle

en.title: Breel Embolo also misses Nations League matches – Swiss football is currently in poor form
en.summary: Forward Breel Embolo is unavailable for the national team due to an unresolved issue involving a falsified COVID certificate. The Swiss Football Association is also facing criticism over the matter.

stories.title: VW muss Millionen Autos wegen drohenden Lenkungsausfalls zurückrufen – auch 50 000 Fahrzeuge in der Schweiz sind betroffen

en.title: VW must recall millions of cars due to imminent steering failure – 50,000 vehicles in Switzerland affected
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi are recalling multiple vehicle models due to a corroding screw that could cause steering system failure. Switzerland has 50,000 affected vehicles.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire est rétabli entre Lausanne et Fribourg après un court-circuit

en.title: Rail traffic restored between Lausanne and Fribourg after short circuit
en.summary: A technical problem temporarily interrupted rail service on the CFF Lausanne-Fribourg line between Puidoux and Vauderens and on the Lausanne-Payerne line between Puidoux and Lucens. Traffic resumed around 18:00 after several hours of disruption, though some delays may persist.

stories.title: Avec son contre-projet sur les loyers, le Conseil fédéral fâche les locataires

en.title: Federal Council counter-proposal on rent regulations angers tenants
en.summary: The Swiss Federal Council rejected a tenant association initiative on limiting abusive rents and proposed an alternative. The counter-proposal satisfies neither tenant advocates nor property owners who had hoped for more favorable provisions.

stories.title: A Neuchâtel, le Conseil d’Etat est critiqué pour son manque de vision et sa gestion de crises

en.title: In Neuchâtel, the State Council is criticized for lack of vision and crisis management
en.summary: Multiple cantonal services and institutions have faced prolonged difficulties, prompting deputies across parties to question the government's responses and criticize its long-term strategic direction.

stories.title: Le trafic CFF est rétabli entre Lausanne et Fribourg

en.title: CFF traffic restored between Lausanne and Fribourg
en.summary: A technical incident at Palézieux station disrupted rail service between Puidoux and Vauderens on the Lausanne-Fribourg line starting at 16:30. Traffic resumed around 18:30, though additional delays remain possible.
